structured_output.what_is_happening: A 10-day-old pump.fun token that had graduated and gone dormant (RICHARD / "Richard Strocher", PumpSwap pair, LP 100% burned) suddenly woke up. In the last ~30 minutes it traded about $51k of volume, roughly 4-5x its market cap, from about 305 unique buyers, and price rose about 350%. At the same moment at least 8 new same-name RICHARD tokens were launched within about 20 minutes of each other; one of them traded $1.2M in the past hour. This looks like a fresh X-driven "Richard Strocher" meme wave, with traders going back to the older token as the "OG". At detection the spike was already fading: price was -22% to -31% over the last 5 minutes and market cap was about $11k, down from an ATH around $69k-equivalent.

narrative.description: An X account/person named 'Richard Strocher' appears to be the subject of a live meme wave; the token links to an X status. The older token can be sold as the 'OG' contract from 10 days before the current wave.
narrative.why_spreading: A cluster of same-name launches in a 20-minute window, one with $1.2M hourly volume, means real attention is on the name right now. OG-hunters will buy the oldest contract.

token_connection.why_this_token: It is the oldest active 'Richard Strocher' pump.fun contract (Sept 16) that still has liquidity, so it has a claim to be the OG. Its revival coincides exactly with the new-launch wave.
token_connection.competing_tokens: At least 9 same-name tokens. 4NU72 has $1.2M h1 volume at $21k mcap, 9PCar has $42k h1 volume and $35k liquidity, 2iFer has $22k liquidity. The RzLN token shows $477k mcap but near-zero liquidity. Attention is heavily fragmented.

authenticity.evidence: About 305 unique buyers and 214 sellers in 30 minutes suggests real breadth. But 482 bundler-tagged and 405 fresh-tagged wallets among traders, a bot/degen rate of 27%, and a serial deployer (21,575 launches, rapidlaunch, creator closed out) all point to heavy bot and farm participation. No paid boosts. The X account has 6 prior usernames (recycled).
authenticity.uncertainty: I can't see the X posts driving the wave, so I can't confirm whether the person or post is actually viral or itself a farmed account.

structural_risks: Liquidity is only ~$8k, so it is very thin and slippage is high
Deployer is a mass launcher with 21k+ tokens
The X account is recycled (6 renames)
Many same-name competitors are draining attention
The spike is already reversing (-22% to -31% over 5 minutes)
dev_team_hold_rate is 14.8% and sniper hold is 14.9%

structured_output.counterargument: Market cap is only ~$11k, and the name is in an active wave producing million-dollar-volume clones. If the wave keeps going, OG-seekers could easily push the 10-day-old contract 2x+ back toward its earlier ~$69k-equivalent ATH. The LP is burned, so it can't be pulled outright. The current 5-minute dip could just be a pullback before a second leg.
unknowns: What the X status says and how viral it is
Whether the crowd settles on a different contract as canonical
Whether the bundler wallets are about to dump
Price path during the 4 minutes before entry

source_coverage.notes: No internet in this condition; judged from the packet only.

structured_output.thesis: This is a revival of the old OG contract during a live same-name meme wave. There is a real, if bot-heavy, buyer base and the market cap is tiny, so 2x is reachable. Working against it: the momentum is already rolling over, a mass deployer and recycled X account are involved, and the attention is split across 9+ clones. It ranks above a typical coin in the pool because the name is live right now, but it is still more likely to chop down or bleed than to double before -50%.
